race_first.route_contract: Race line remains the primary avenue. Both legal alternatives determine the city envelope.

elevation_note: Authored C2 land/street profile shared with baked Metropolis; no separate hills district.
route_contract: One split, two alternatives, one rejoin. Common ordered gates at split/rejoin; edge-relative progress and branch recovery require future runtime integration.
construction_limits: Local planning coordinates. Street-first polygon sites, not accepted building architecture. Junction controls, complete lot access/terrain support, bridges and runtime IDs/quotas need later construction validation.

detail_policy.hero: Authored frontage, ground-floor depth, trim, roof edges and close materials.
detail_policy.standard: Complete building envelope; simpler trim, instanced windows and fewer unique materials.
detail_policy.skyline: Complete silhouette, roof form and major facade rhythm; baked window/detail patterns.
detail_policy.massing: Closed block/building volumes and stable roof/material identity; no small trim.
detail_policy.skyline_anchor_floor: All interior towers retain at least skyline detail, regardless of road distance.
detail_policy.runtime_lod: Separate future camera LOD with shared origins, ready transitions and identity-preserving silhouettes. Never roof-only shells; no collider or hazard downgrade.

massing.scope: Offline height/site/detail authoring only; no 3D geometry or runtime LOD implemented.

massing.note: Authored detail allocation, not measured runtime LOD/performance.
